title: Tiered soft-apply & statistical rollback advisor for safe batching/caching tuning
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a conservative, multi-stage application strategy for automated batching and KV-cache recommendations that minimizes customer-visible SLO regressions. The feature will: 1) propose tuned batching and cache profiles per route/tenant, 2) apply changes progressively using a tiered soft-apply ladder (shadow -> sampled apply -> ramp -> full apply), and 3) rely on statistical rollbacks based on tail-latency and throughput windows rather than simple threshold crossings. The goal is to unlock cost savings while keeping latency/availability regressions below agreed SLO budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor produces per-route profiles with expected token-per-second and p99 latency impact estimates
Automated rollout supports four stages: shadow, 1% sampled apply, traffic ramping (1%->25%->100%), and full apply
Rollback trigger evaluates p95/p99 shifts using bootstrap confidence intervals with a minimum sample size and aborts within the same rollout window
Canary metrics include per-tenant weighted latency, error-rate, throughput, and cache-hit deltas; stored in a retrievable dashboard
Operator UI shows recommended profiles, expected savings, and one-click rollback with forensic links to trace samples
design_notes: Shadow stage executes tuning logic without affecting runtime decisions, collecting latency and cache-hit baseline for comparison
Use stratified sampling to ensure inclusive representation of long-tail tenants and heavy-token requests during sampled apply
Apply statistical tests (bootstrap-based CI on median/p95/p99) to avoid noisy early rollbacks; require at least 2000 requests or 30 minutes of data per cohort before gating full-stage promotion
Introduce a ramp cap per region and per model family to avoid correlated load shifts across customers
Maintain a soft-budget for throughput SLOs; allow temporary controlled throttles when safe (graceful degradation with lower-cost model variants)
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Advisor engine prototype that analyzes historical prefix-length distributions and suggests batch/window sizes and KV cache TTLs
Phase 2: Shadow-mode collector and difference dashboard; store per-route baseline and candidate metrics in observability store
Phase 3: Implement tiered rollout controller with sampling hooks in the runtime and early abort signals
Phase 4: Statistical rollback library and CI tests; integrate alarms and automated rollback action
Phase 5: UX polish in Console: recommended profile view, rollout timeline, override controls, and audit logs
metrics_and_slo_definitions: Primary latency SLO: p95_latency <= baseline_p95 + 10ms or max(1.05 * baseline_p95, baseline_p95 + 10ms)
Tail safety: p99 must not regress by more than 5% relative or 30ms absolute within any rollout stage
Throughput SLO: sustained RPS for the cohort must not drop more than 3% vs baseline during ramp
Cost objective: expected per-token CPU/GPU cost reduction >= 8% for the candidate profile
Rollback window: automatic rollback if CI shows regression with 95% confidence and minimum sample size reached
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy metrics on low-traffic routes cause false rollbacks. Mitigation: group low-traffic routes into cohorts and increase sample window; add minimum-traffic holdout
Risk: correlated rollouts across tenants generate regional load spikes. Mitigation: global rollout coordinator with regional caps and randomized staging
Risk: hidden correctness regressions due to batching semantics. Mitigation: include synthetic replay checks against golden outputs during shadow and sampled apply
Risk: operator confusion on recommended savings vs observed. Mitigation: surface conservative expected ranges and confidence intervals in the Console
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff sync with runtime, observability, and console teams. Agreed on shadow-first approach and sample size targets.
2026-03-05: Advisor prototype completed; initial profiles computed on last 7 days of traffic. Early results show 10-12% cost delta on moderate-traffic routes.
2026-03-08: Implemented shadow collector; ran 6-hour replay across staging traffic. No user-visible regressions observed in shadow metrics.
2026-03-11: Statistical rollback lib PR opened (draft); using bootstrap CI with configurable alpha and min-samples. Need perf review from observability infra.
2026-03-12: Planning for sampled-apply experiment next week. Ops requested region rate limits and an emergency abort webhook for immediate rollback.
